title: Major depression: episode, severity and remission
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's depressive disorder.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for MDD.

HPI
Pt is a 61 y/o male presenting for scheduled follow-up of major depressive disorder, single episode. Pt reports stable mood over the past several months. Denies any current symptoms of low mood, loss of interest, or fatigue. Reports improved sleep and appetite. Pt states he feels well and is meeting daily goals. No acute concerns voiced today.

Medication List
Sertraline 50mg PO QD

Exam
Pt appears well-groomed and in no acute distress. Speech is normal rate and volume. Affect is congruent with mood. Insight and judgment intact. Thought process linear. Vitals stable.

Assessment
1. Major depressive disorder, single episode. Currently in full remission.

Plan
1. Continue current medication as prescribed.
2. Pt to continue monitoring mood and report any changes.
3. Follow up in 3 months for routine evaluation.

Electronically signed, K. Nguyen, DO, 05/14/2026
explanations: Major depressive disorder, single episode, in full remission (no HCC): F32.5.

distractors.why: The provider documents full remission: code the remission, not an active severity.
The remission is full, not partial.
